sources.title: Warhounds on Steam
sources.version_boundary: English Steam listing observed after the August 11, 2026 release

claims.statement: Warhounds names five classes: Assault, Specialist, Sniper, Machine Gunner, and Grenadier.
The official site describes ten unique veteran mercenaries with traits, stories, and abilities.
The roster can also be expanded with recruits who grow through combat and training.
Soldiers can be upgraded and equipped, and the official combat description presents different weapons, gear, abilities, and tactical tools.
The official site describes five factions with distinct soldiers and tactics, while Steam states that relationships affect allied support.

unknowns: The checked official sources do not establish a universal best-class tier list.
Exact class skill trees, recruit stat ranges, optimal squad size, and veteran rankings are not asserted.
The guide's squad patterns are role-coverage frameworks rather than fixed meta compositions.
